definition: willing to give and share with others
description: A hen pecks along a trail of yellow corn spilled over snowy boards beside a wooden fence and squeezes through the gap. She then looks down into a round hole dug in the earth, with a small blue-grey mouse standing at the bottom looking up, and pushes the corn down into it. At the bottom of the hole a family of mice gathers round a big heap of corn lit by a candle.
